argv:
set -eu
dev=$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/dev); sys=$(readlink -f /sys/class/block/sdb/device)
[ "$dev" = 8:16 ]; case "$sys" in */1:0:0:0) ;; *) exit 41 ;; esac
[ "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/device/queue_depth)" = 316 ]
[ "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/queue/nr_requests)" = 1024 ]
case "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/queue/scheduler)" in *'[mq-deadline]'*) ;; *) exit 42 ;; esac
[ "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/queue/iosched/async_depth)" = 256 ]
printf 'dev=%s|sys=%s|nr_requests=%s|depth=%s|scheduler=%s|async_depth=%s\n' "$dev" "$sys" \
  "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/queue/nr_requests)" "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/device/queue_depth)" \
  "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/queue/scheduler)" "$(cat /sys/class/block/sdb/queue/iosched/async_depth)"
